tagline: Content editing for Astro, kept in Git
description: Mica gives your Astro website forms, a live preview and Publish. Content stays as JSON and Markdoc in Git, and Astro builds static pages. No database.

status.label: experimental
status.bannerText: Mica is experimental and not ready for production. The API and the content format can still change, so read the release notes before you upgrade.
